keys.potato_quotes: ["还刷呢？刷到土豆雷，就要去学习。现在退出抖音，快去学习。","我是土豆雷，我要爆炸了。你偷懒的时候，别人也在努力。","恭喜你踩到地雷，地雷已引爆，关掉抖音立刻去学习。","考研的阅卷分数，不会包容你的懈怠。别再用“之后再学”欺骗自己，现在就动笔！","请不要假装看不见我，退出抖音去学习。听见没，快去！","住手，不要再刷短视频逃避背诵！考研的名额不会留给一直拖延的人。","别把备考全部留给“等一会”，状态不会主动找上门，是行动才把状态带出来。","刷到即是土豆雷触发成功，先完成眼下最小的任务，再安心休息。","别骗自己考前突击就能上岸，现在偷的懒，考场上都会变成拦路虎。","时间不会等你，放下手机，现在就去学习，别等深夜才后悔今天又虚度。","今日欠的习题，考场上都会变成难题，三天打鱼式复习很难上岸。","你多摸鱼的每一分钟，都在拉大你和对手的差距。","晚上到了，停止无意义熬夜，立刻放下手机，养好精神来日全力赶路。","你以为只是随便刷刷，不知不觉时间就被掏空。放下手机，立刻行动。","你要像石灰一样，别人越泼冷水，你越沸腾。","焦虑的时候可以学习，迷茫的时候可以学习。先去做，哪怕做成一坨屎。","昨天玩了一整天还没玩够吗？要不然咱们别考了？直接放弃，少一个竞争对手。","所谓的亲密关系远不如伟大前途重要。好好学习，我们一研为定！","你今天每刷一个视频，就是给以后的竞争对手多让一条路。","你可以难过，可以疲惫，可以偶尔停下，但别轻易放弃。你要的未来在每一次不认输里。","看似毫无进展，直到一切突然改变。身体入场，现在开始。","真正能走远的人，都是一边崩溃一边自愈、一边狼狈一边坚持。","滴滴滴滴滴——砰！你已触发土豆雷，停止刷手机，立马去学习，时间不会等犹豫不决的人。","不要等绝佳状态，清晨困乏可以学，任务堆积可以学，自我怀疑也可以学，专注是学出来的。","你刷的每一分钟，都在缩小你上岸的概率；现在逃避背书，考场就会狠狠为难你。","别人越是瞧不上你，你越要努力；别人越是打击你，你越要做出成绩来。"]

In conclusion, reading not only enriches our mind but also shapes our character, and it is truly a lifelong treasure."},{"id":"et3","title":"Should We Study Abroad?","cn":"以“大学生是否应该出国留学”为题，写一篇 150 词左右的短文，表明你的观点。","en":"Write an essay of about 150 words on whether college students should study abroad, presenting your own view.","keywords":"study abroad; culture; independence; cost; choice","wordGoal":150,"sample":"Whether to study abroad has become a heated topic among college students. In my view, if family conditions allow, studying abroad is a worthwhile choice, because the knowledge and experience gained cannot be measured by money. Yet students should also consider their own goals and prepare themselves mentally before leaving. All in all, studying abroad is not for everyone, but for those who seize it, it is a life-changing opportunity."},{"id":"et4","title":"Protecting the Environment","cn":"以“保护环境，人人有责”为题，写一篇 120 词左右的短文。","en":"Write an essay of about 120 words on the topic \"Everyone Is Responsible for Protecting the Environment\".","keywords":"environment; pollution; responsibility; action; future","wordGoal":120,"sample":"Environmental protection is no longer an option but an urgent duty for everyone. However, many people still think that protecting the environment is only the government's responsibility. In fact, every small action counts: saving water and electricity, using public transport, and refusing disposable plastic bags. If everyone makes a little effort every day, the combined power will be enormous. As the saying goes, \"Many hands make light work.\" Let us start from ourselves and from now on, so that our children can enjoy a cleaner and greener world."},{"id":"et5","title":"My View on Online Learning","cn":"以“我对线上学习的看法”为题，写一篇 150 词左右的短文。","en":"Write an essay of about 150 words on your view of online learning.","keywords":"online learning; convenience; flexibility; self-discipline; challenge","wordGoal":150,"sample":"In recent years, online learning has become increasingly popular among students. Without face-to-face communication, some students may feel isolated, and those who lack self-discipline may easily fall behind. From my perspective, online learning is a powerful tool, but it requires strong self-management. The key is to set clear goals, make a study plan, and stick to it. Moreover, friendship teaches us to trust and to be honest, which are important qualities for our whole life.
